# MMC HR

> > MMC HR is a comprehensive HR outsourcing and payroll expert offering end-to-end solutions for businesses across multiple industries.

MMC HR provides integrated HR outsourcing, payroll processing, benefits administration, talent management, and compliance services to businesses nationwide. With locations across California and partnerships with industry leaders, MMC HR serves diverse sectors including healthcare, education, nonprofits, and accounting firms.

## Key Topics

- HR Outsourcing
- Payroll Processing
- Benefits Administration
- 401(k) Retirement Plans
- HRIS (Human Resource Information System)
- Compliance & Audits
- Talent Acquisition & Recruitment
- Time & Labor Management
- Risk Management
- Employee Training
- W-2 & Tax Filings
- Cost Savings
- Ready Scheduler
- Ready Recruiting
- MMC University
